context: 1722.04 points got scored across the league this week, 143.5 per team -- make of that what you will. Nobody topped VRDNO's 224.96, good for the 3rd-best week any team has ever had.

awards.name: Best Bench
awards.text: Somewhere, Jordan Love is still on Bandits's bench wondering why -- 42.28 points' worth of wondering, out of 85.18 total left stranded.

awards.name: You Didn't Lose!
awards.text: Supernova Takeover scored just 116.54 -- the 8th-highest score in the league this week -- but Hurts Over 10.5int @-1000 somehow scored even less (105.92), so the win counts all the same.

awards.name: Great Defense!
awards.text: ROK Navy's Finest's defense (well, their opponent's offense) did the work: Newman’s Owen finished with just 93.5.

awards.name: Mega Blowout
awards.text: The week's biggest mismatch: Jake From State Farm over Chig-a-Doodle-Doo, 174.18-108.84 (65.34 points).
